title: BLK GRVTY Franchise Nova Cocktail Mixer
description:
Think franchise ownership is out of reach? You may be closer to building wealth than you think.

Ownership is the new job. Franchising is one of the most structured pathways to business ownership in the country, with nearly $900 billion a year and 9 million jobs. And it isn’t just food. It’s childcare, senior care, pet care, and home services, with 12,000 new locations projected next year. How many will you own?

BLK GRVTY built Franchise Nova to close the ownership gap, with a readiness assessment, a scoring system to find your best fit, and capital partners reviewing deals.

Who should be here
Current operators and anyone serious about ownership. You don’t need a business plan or all the capital. You need a guide.

The night
Cocktails and conversation with our team, operators, and capital partners. Come with questions. Leave knowing what it takes.

How to join
Spots are limited and reviewed. Request your spot, then check your email (and spam) to finish registering.

title: Third Ward Walking Tour
description:
The Third Ward Walking Tour will introduce attendees to the heritage of Third Ward, a historic neighborhood in Houston and a hub for Black culture. The tour will highlight local businesses like Kindred Stories, a Black-owned bookstore; the Eldorado Ballroom, a venue that hosted musical legends like Etta James, Arnett Cobb, and Ray Charles and inspired the traveling event series by Solange; and Emancipation Park, which has hosted Juneteenth celebrations since 1872.

We will close out the tour at Project Row Houses, a community platform that enriches lives through art where attendees will see a new exhibition and enjoy art, drinks, and music at Glow on the Row!

Learn more about the neighborhood and upcoming events at thirdwardculture.org/calendar!

This event is facilitated by Project Row Houses and the Third Ward Cultural District. It is funded in part by the Texas Commission on the Arts.

title: Can We Build the Next Virtual Patient?
address: The Ion, 4201 Main St, Houston, TX 77002
description:
​What if we could test a treatment on a virtual version of you before treating you?​

This edition of Evening Rounds explores digital twin technology in healthcare: how it is being used today, where it could meaningfully improve patient outcomes, and what would have to be true for virtual representations of patients to become useful in real-world care.

 ​What would it take to simulate a patient well enough to change how we train, test, research and deliver care?

title: Faith at the Frontier: Building the Future of Technology & Community
description:
​An Intimate Dinner Experience for Faith-Driven Founders, Community Builders & Innovation Leaders

​Join One99 Labs during AfroTech Week for an intimate, curated dinner bringing together faith-driven founders, community builders, investors, and innovation leaders to explore what becomes possible when technology and community intersect.

​As emerging technologies reshape how we connect, build, and scale, we'll explore opportunities to collaborate, support faith-driven entrepreneurs, and leverage our collective networks, expertise, and resources to expand Kingdom impact.

​From technology founders developing solutions to real world challenges to community leaders leveraging digital platforms to expand Kingdom impact, this gathering explores what becomes possible when those building technology connect with those building communities.

​Together, we'll examine how our collective expertise, networks, and resources can accelerate entrepreneurship, create new economic opportunities.
